$comment: Content for the 2026 announcement graphics. Edit this, then run: node graphics/build-announcements.mjs. Headlines take the punchy part of the talk title; the full title, speakers and slot go in the body. '|' is a line break, and the renderer shrinks display type to fit, so a longer name will not break the layout.
